summary_short: Krishna explains devotion as the simplest and most loving path to peace.
summary_medium: Arjuna asks which path is better—devotion to the personal form or meditation on the formless. Krishna explains that devotion is easier and then describes the qualities of a true devotee.
summary_detailed: Comparison of personal and impersonal worship.
Devotion is easier for most people.
what_you_learn: Why effort matters more than perfection.
How love becomes a spiritual path.
What true devotion looks like in daily life.
How to remain peaceful amid chaos.
usage_note_for_app: Chapter 12 is ideal for daily notifications, emotional support flows, and gentle guidance.
